# The moor under the hero: a 12 x 10 m plane, its texture (ground.png) the moor with the lantern's
# pool of light. It rides with the camera (one bone), so it must stay uniform outside the pool.
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Ground --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material texture Ground base-color ground.png
add mesh plane --name Ground --size 1
scale 12.0 10.0 1
apply --scale
material assign Ground
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
export ground.glb
